critical_code_review_comments: All 15 feature requirements from Sprint 1 are implemented and working correctly
Conflict detection logic handles parent/child/sibling relationships properly
Catering workflow correctly creates CateringRequest + Task with proper linking
Status transitions mirror correctly between CateringRequest and Task
Capability gates working as designed - member role has NO resources caps by default
DateTime serialization bug was already fixed (ISO string conversion in _check_conflicts)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 223 completed comprehensive backend testing of the new Resources & Bookings module (Sprint 1). All 15 feature requirements verified: resource CRUD with type filters, splitable rooms with children, booking conflict detection (direct/parent-child/sibling), approval workflow, catering workflow with Task integration, capability gates. Member role has NO resources caps by default (view:resources, resources.book) - this is by design. Frontend not yet implemented (Sprint 2). Demo data seeded via seed_resources_demo.py.
